items.title: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
items.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
items.summary: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
items.description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.
top_comments: Hey Product Hunters 👋 Last time we launched Naoma here as an AI demo agent, and you made it #1 Product of the Day and #1 Product of the Month in Marketing. That launch is the reason everything below exists, so: thank you. Since then the agent has run 50,000 live demos on real B2B SaaS products - UXPressia, Hoteza, AiSDR and others - in 33 languages, at every hour of the day. Three things we didn't expect: 1. Nobody actually wanted more demos. They wanted fewer unqualified ones. The demo was never the bottleneck, the rep's calendar was. 2. Buyers come back, and restarting the demo from zero loses them. So the agent now recognizes returning visitors and asks where they want to pick up. 3. The conversion gap was bigger than we modeled. A "book a demo" button converts 1-2% of visitors. An agent that simply runs the demo converts 6-20%, depending on the product and the audience. So we stopped describing Naoma as a demo agent. Today we're launching it as an AI AE: it runs the demo on your live product, answers the pricing and edge-case questions, qualifies the buyer against your criteria, sends the big deals to your team and everyone else to self-serve, and writes the session back to your CRM. And the part that makes us nervous: it's self-serve now. Upload your product, build the agent yourself, have it live today - no call with us. That felt like the only honest option for a product whose entire argument is that you shouldn't have to book a call. One question, and I'll reply to every answer: if you put this on your site tomorrow, what's the one thing it would have to get right before you'd trust it in front of your buyers? Don't take our word for it - the agent on naoma.ai will demo Naoma to you.

Great use case. It's not just about not losing leads, but also about saving time and energy of AEs. Running the same demo over and over can be tiring, and it's a much better use of human talent to focus on deeper discussions and harder questions instead. Good luck!

items.title: Slashy Assistant
items.name: Slashy Assistant
items.summary: The AI assistant that does email for you
items.description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.
top_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Harsha, co-founder/ceo of Slashy (can text me any questions at 262-271 5339). When we first launched Slashy, we asked why every AI email tool felt the same. They could all generate text, but they didn’t understand who you were talking to, what happened in your last meeting, what was stored in your CRM, or how you actually communicated. So we built an AI-native email client that could learn how you work and do email with you. But we kept running into another problem: a real assistant can’t be trapped inside your inbox. Your work is spread across multiple inboxes, your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and other tools. And you still need things done when you’re away from your desk. So today, we’re launching Slashy Assistant. Connect your tools, and within five minutes Slashy starts building the context it needs to help. It can draft replies in your voice, triage what matters, schedule meetings, prepare you for calls, track who owes you a reply, and find follow-ups that are about to slip. You can ask the assistant for help inside the Slashy email client, or reach the same assistant outside your inbox through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. It knows the same people, conversations, commitments, and preferences wherever you talk to it. And now Slashy doesn’t always have to wait for you to ask. Connect it to the tools you already use, then create automations in plain English: ✅ “Every morning, archive obvious spam and cold pitches, unsubscribe from repeat senders, and send me a summary.” ✅ “Before every meeting, combine my calendar, CRM, past emails, and meeting notes into a briefing.” ✅ “After every customer call, use the meeting notes to draft a follow-up and update the contact in my CRM.” ✅ “Text me on iMessage when an important customer replies.” ✅ “Every Friday, find conversations that have gone quiet and draft follow-ups.” You can connect Slashy to your CRM, meeting notetaker, calendar, and other tools through integrations and MCP. Once an automation is created, it keeps running proactively in the background. Our goal is simple: build an assistant that already understands your work, notices what needs attention, and is reachable wherever you happen to be. 🎁 Product Hunt exclusive: new customers can use code PRODUCTHUNT to get their first month of Slashy free. We’ll be here all day answering every comment. I’d love to know: what’s the first email task you’d ask Slashy to automate? 👇

items.title: Oats
items.name: Oats
items.summary: Free, open-source, and on device meeting notetaker
items.description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.
top_comments:
Hey Product Hunt! 👋

We think AI meeting notes have become useful enough to be a basic utility. And basic utilities should be free, open source, and private by default.

That’s why we built Oats 🥣 -- a free, open-source AI meeting note taker for Mac & Windows.

Why Oats?

Most AI meeting tools require a bot to join your calls, send your conversations to the cloud, lock useful features behind a subscription, or use your data in ways that aren’t always obvious.

We wanted a different option.

Oats runs locally on your computer. It can record your meetings without a bot joining the call, then transcribe and summarize the conversation on-device, using local AI models.

Your recordings stay local. And because Oats is open source, you can use it, audit it, modify it, or build on top of it.

No meeting bot. No model training on your data. No data lock-in.

What you can do with Oats:

  • Record meetings without inviting a bot

  • Transcribe and summarize locally

  • Keep recordings on your own computer

  • Run with on-device LLMs

  • Inspect and modify the source code

  • Use it completely free

For those who want more, Oats can also connect to the Ariso cloud backend for enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessments, coaching, automatic follow-up tracking, and more.

Even when you use our cloud features, we will never use your meeting data to train our models, including on the free plan.

Oats is also our first step toward open-sourcing more of what we build at Ariso.

So we’d love the Product Hunt community to put it through its paces. Tell us what’s missing. Break something. Open an issue. Build something weird on top of it. Or contribute directly. 🥣

We’ll be here all day answering questions.

— The Ariso Team

Congrats on launch!! 👍
was looking for a local notetaker to actually use, so good timing! on-device + no bot is the right call. Any plans for mobile though? a fair few of my meetings happen away from the laptop, and an on-device phone version is the thing i'd actually use daily.

anyway, thanks for making this. i really needed it 😃
Respect for the privacy and no-subscription approach!

items.title: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
items.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
items.summary: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
items.description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.
top_comments: Hey Product Hunters 👋 Last time we launched Naoma here as an AI demo agent, and you made it #1 Product of the Day and #1 Product of the Month in Marketing. That launch is the reason everything below exists, so: thank you. Since then the agent has run 50,000 live demos on real B2B SaaS products - UXPressia, Hoteza, AiSDR and others - in 33 languages, at every hour of the day. Three things we didn't expect: 1. Nobody actually wanted more demos. They wanted fewer unqualified ones. The demo was never the bottleneck, the rep's calendar was. 2. Buyers come back, and restarting the demo from zero loses them. So the agent now recognizes returning visitors and asks where they want to pick up. 3. The conversion gap was bigger than we modeled. A "book a demo" button converts 1-2% of visitors. An agent that simply runs the demo converts 6-20%, depending on the product and the audience. So we stopped describing Naoma as a demo agent. Today we're launching it as an AI AE: it runs the demo on your live product, answers the pricing and edge-case questions, qualifies the buyer against your criteria, sends the big deals to your team and everyone else to self-serve, and writes the session back to your CRM. And the part that makes us nervous: it's self-serve now. Upload your product, build the agent yourself, have it live today - no call with us. That felt like the only honest option for a product whose entire argument is that you shouldn't have to book a call. One question, and I'll reply to every answer: if you put this on your site tomorrow, what's the one thing it would have to get right before you'd trust it in front of your buyers? Don't take our word for it - the agent on naoma.ai will demo Naoma to you.

Great use case. It's not just about not losing leads, but also about saving time and energy of AEs. Running the same demo over and over can be tiring, and it's a much better use of human talent to focus on deeper discussions and harder questions instead. Good luck!
What other new features are you planning to roll out in the near future?

items.title: Slashy Assistant
items.name: Slashy Assistant
items.summary: The AI assistant that does email for you
items.description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.
top_comments: Hey Product Hunt 👋 I’m Harsha, co-founder/ceo of Slashy (can text me any questions at 262-271 5339). When we first launched Slashy, we asked why every AI email tool felt the same. They could all generate text, but they didn’t understand who you were talking to, what happened in your last meeting, what was stored in your CRM, or how you actually communicated. So we built an AI-native email client that could learn how you work and do email with you. But we kept running into another problem: a real assistant can’t be trapped inside your inbox. Your work is spread across multiple inboxes, your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and other tools. And you still need things done when you’re away from your desk. So today, we’re launching Slashy Assistant. Connect your tools, and within five minutes Slashy starts building the context it needs to help. It can draft replies in your voice, triage what matters, schedule meetings, prepare you for calls, track who owes you a reply, and find follow-ups that are about to slip. You can ask the assistant for help inside the Slashy email client, or reach the same assistant outside your inbox through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. It knows the same people, conversations, commitments, and preferences wherever you talk to it. And now Slashy doesn’t always have to wait for you to ask. Connect it to the tools you already use, then create automations in plain English: ✅ “Every morning, archive obvious spam and cold pitches, unsubscribe from repeat senders, and send me a summary.” ✅ “Before every meeting, combine my calendar, CRM, past emails, and meeting notes into a briefing.” ✅ “After every customer call, use the meeting notes to draft a follow-up and update the contact in my CRM.” ✅ “Text me on iMessage when an important customer replies.” ✅ “Every Friday, find conversations that have gone quiet and draft follow-ups.” You can connect Slashy to your CRM, meeting notetaker, calendar, and other tools through integrations and MCP. Once an automation is created, it keeps running proactively in the background. Our goal is simple: build an assistant that already understands your work, notices what needs attention, and is reachable wherever you happen to be. 🎁 Product Hunt exclusive: new customers can use code PRODUCTHUNT to get their first month of Slashy free. We’ll be here all day answering every comment. I’d love to know: what’s the first email task you’d ask Slashy to automate? 👇

just switched from superhuman to slashy-- no regrets so far!

i think it's auto-drafts are way better and their harness is very good, but UX could use some clean up! regardless, i'm moving through email fast and getting things done quicker, and that's what matters

It saves me a huge amount of time across email, scheduling, and follow-ups, and the new Assistant takes it to another level. Congrats to Harsha and the team on the launch!

Been using it for 6 month!

interest_sections.title: AI 宠物陪伴
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub；独居场景已被普遍视为孤立无援，但真正缺口不在于解闷聊天，而在于让 AI 成为能持续记住个人状态并代为处理琐事的长期生活伙伴。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是老人靠刷手机、看电视、摆弄花草消磨时间，年轻人硬扛或点外卖，技术上已有如 GitHub 上 giftia 这类带认知记忆、多 Agent 协作的 AI 情感陪伴助手，试图把聊天式陪伴变成有记忆、能分工的固定助手。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的方向是把 AI 陪伴从“安慰式聊天”推进到能记住用户健康档案、生活规律并主动承担提醒、陪诊、代办等真实照护动作的生活伴侣 Agent。

interest_sections.title: AI 学习工具
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub：学习与科研中真正的痛点是文献整理、写作表达和知识点检索的重复劳动，当前解法仍偏手动或单科网页工具，下一步应关注能嵌入这些具体流程并“越用越懂你”的Agent式辅助。

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是高中生靠按学科整理的网页工具（如地理考点梳理、交互式元素周期表）逐点查漏，文科研究生则靠手动精读（中文2-4天/篇、外文6-10天/篇）并用统计软件反复调参试数据，GitHub上已有自托管、带记忆自进化能力的Agent尝试把这类任务收进一个入口。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得跟踪的是把模型能力下沉到文献精读、写作口吻调整和数据调试等具体动作中，同时按学科/章节把知识做结构化索引与即时查询，形成能随使用积累偏好的自进化学习辅助。

interest_sections.title: AI 任务管理
interest_sections.summary: 这一组信号主要来自 zhihu、GitHub，核心观察是任务管理工具因功能堆叠而变重、自身成为卡顿与操作成本来源，需求正从“看得全”转向“一句话就把具体任务定位并处理掉”。

items.title: 需求
items.paragraph: 用户最明确的需求是系统卡死或任务堆积时能一步定位并处置那个具体进程或待办，而不是在膨胀的界面里反复搜索、或干脆重启了事

items.title: 现状
items.paragraph: 现状是任务管理工具普遍越加越重——任务管理器膨胀成资源驾驶舱、日程/项目管理应用靠海量自定义字段和模板撑流程——讨论集中在用缓冲区批量取进程数据、按模块拆分应用避免一崩全崩，以及像 Feishu-MCP、vococo 那样把任务操作接进 AI 编码工具或语音口令。

items.title: 方向跟踪
items.paragraph: 值得继续跟踪的方向是把“定位并处置某个具体任务或进程”做成模型可直接调用的原子动作，用一句话或一段语音替代在重量级 GUI 里搜索、结束、派发的整条链路。
